name: claude-skills
description: A collection of custom skills for Claude Code — flat peer-agent coordination (teammates), disciplined codebase editing (codebase-guardian), durable hierarchical memory (memory), the DOX AGENTS.md contract hierarchy (agents-dox), semantic code navigation via language servers (lsp), schema-aware database work (schema-aware-db), end-of-session loose-end wrap-up (ponytail), fast calibrated decisions via TypeSafe Jev with user-managed providers (decision-maker), run-and-report feature testing for web, backend, and mobile (test-report), your own commit/branch/PR rules with hidden attribution (git-conventions), and a panel-driven product manager that maps goal, state, and features and acts on its own (product-visionary). The skills work standalone and compose with each other.

plugins.name: teammates
plugins.description: Run any task as a flat team of Claude Code subagents — no orchestrator, no hierarchy. Agents share a JSON manifest, claim work, message each other, and merge outputs.

plugins.name: codebase-guardian
plugins.description: A disciplined four-phase loop for editing existing codebases safely — validate against the real toolchain, match or deliberately change the existing pattern, trace the ripple, and record learnings to MEMORY.md. Covers TypeScript/Node, Python/Django, Flutter/Dart, and Rust/Tauri.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Maintain durable, hierarchical memory files for the user and for codebases so context persists across sessions — bootstrap, read, and update MEMORY.md at the repo root and per module, plus user-level USER.md. The persistence layer codebase-guardian builds on.

plugins.name: agents-dox
plugins.description: The DOX framework — a high-performance AGENTS.md hierarchy where each AGENTS.md is a binding work contract for its subtree. Read the applicable root-to-nearest chain of AGENTS.md before editing, and run a DOX pass to update the owning AGENTS.md and affected parents/children after every meaningful change. Bootstraps the tree if a repo has none.

plugins.name: lsp
plugins.description: Semantic code navigation via real language servers — go-to-definition, find-references, hover, symbols, diagnostics, and safe project-wide rename for TypeScript/Node, Python, Dart/Flutter, and Rust. Ships a stdlib-only Python LSP client; falls back to grep when no server is installed.

plugins.name: schema-aware-db
plugins.description: Stop guessing database schemas. A four-phase discipline for backend data code (SQL and NoSQL) — introspect the real schema, map every usage across the codebase, write the change to industry standard, then trace the ripple so no query, migration, serializer, or test goes stale.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Wrap up a work session so nothing is left dangling — sweep every loose strand (uncommitted or unpushed work, unlabeled stashes, session debris, promises recorded nowhere), tie each one off, and leave a single 'session tail' report the next session can pick up without archaeology.

plugins.name: decision-maker
plugins.description: Fast, cheap, calibrated decisions via TypeSafe's Jev System One model — typed yes/no, choice, and score answers with confidence, batched in one call. User-managed providers (TypeSafe, OpenRouter, OpenJEV, LiteLLM, or any System One gateway) with editable base URL and API key, plus decision recipes for every other skill in this repo. Stdlib-only Python client; falls back to Claude's own judgment when unconfigured. Opt-in guard hooks check edits and commands against CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md rules and the user's request, answer Claude's questions when confident (asking the user only when not), and compare the diff with the request before Claude finishes.

plugins.name: test-report
plugins.description: Test features or a branch across web, backend, and mobile — write 2 positive and 1 negative test per feature in the project's own framework, actually run them, and write a Markdown pass/fail report with failure causes and a re-run command.

plugins.name: product-visionary
plugins.description: Your product's visionary manager — infers the goal, where the product stands, and how every feature connects to it; finds real issues via test-report; a 3/6/9-agent panel debates and decides; then acts per a session-start mode: report only, fix on a branch, full auto, or complete auto.

plugins.name: git-conventions
plugins.description: Make Claude's commits, branches and PRs follow your rules — commit message pattern, branch naming, PR template, protected branches — and hide Claude's name via the native attribution setting. Asks before any settings change; never rewrites history.
